citation: Anscombe, F. J. (1973), Graphs in Statistical Analysis, The American Statistician 27(1), 17-21, DOI 10.1080/00031305.1973.10478966 -- the eleven (x, y) pairs of data set 1, read from the unnumbered table on p. 19 captioned 'Four data sets, each comprising 11 (x, y) pairs'.
notes: The x column is printed once in the source and shared by data sets 1 to 3; the y column here is the one headed '1'. WHAT THIS CASE CLAIMS AND WHAT IT DOES NOT: it claims that eleven published pairs reach the wire form with every digit intact, through the sequence and float branches of to_mcp. It claims nothing about any method -- Anscombe's point is that these four data sets share every regression summary, so the pairs are evidence about transport and not about estimation.
